name: mae-ai
title: Pocket AI
description: Stream chat, define, translate, polish writing, or connect Hermes/OpenClaw with your own provider.
author: edliu_microsoft

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Ask a question and stream the answer from your own provider.

commands.name: dictionary
commands.title: AI Dictionary
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Explain a word with pronunciation, definitions, and examples.

commands.name: translator
commands.title: AI Translator
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Translate text into your chosen language.

commands.name: polisher
commands.title: AI Polish Text
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Improve grammar, clarity, and tone without changing meaning.

commands.name: remote-agents
commands.title: Remote Agents
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Choose the Ask AI backend and server URL in the shared settings screen.

commands.name: configure-provider
commands.title: Configure AI Provider
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Set your OpenAI-compatible API endpoint and optional API key. No special command syntax is required.

commands.name: create-command
commands.title: Add New Command
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Create your own AI command from an Ask AI, Dictionary, Translator, Polish, or blank template.

commands.name: manage-tools
commands.title: Pocket AI Settings
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Select a command to edit its prompt, placeholders, model, and translation language. Add new template-based commands, delete commands, or restore deleted built-ins.

commands.name: custom-tool
commands.title: Run Custom AI Tool
commands.subtitle: Pocket AI
commands.description: Run a saved tool, including through a dedicated Quicklink shortcut.

preferences.name: responseView
preferences.title: Response View
preferences.description: Rich Markdown shows formatted replies and image links beside the conversation. Full-width text follows streamed rows. Raycast controls scrolling inside the native Markdown pane. You can also switch views from Actions.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Endpoint
preferences.description: Paste your OpenAI-compatible base URL or full /chat/completions URL. The default expects a local VS Code Copilot bridge; configure your own provider if it is not running.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Paste your provider's key here. Leave empty if your local provider does not require authentication. Do not include the word Bearer.

preferences.name: hermesKey
preferences.title: Hermes API Key
preferences.description: Your Hermes API_SERVER_KEY. Choose the backend and URL in Pocket AI's Remote Agents command. This never inherits the direct-model API key.

preferences.name: openclawToken
preferences.title: OpenClaw Gateway Token / Password
preferences.description: Your gateway shared token or password. Choose the backend and URL in Pocket AI's Remote Agents command. Changing this credential requires pairing a new device identity.
